question: Find out how many actors have a 'Shahrukh number' of 2? This means they acted in a film with someone who acted with Shahrukh Khan, but not directly with him.
sql:
WITH shahrukh_pid AS (
    SELECT PID FROM Person WHERE Name = 'Shahrukh Aksari'
),
movies_with_shahrukh AS (
    SELECT MID FROM M_Cast WHERE PID IN (SELECT PID FROM shahrukh_pid)
),
actors_with_shahrukh AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT PID FROM M_Cast 
    WHERE MID IN (SELECT MID FROM movies_with_shahrukh)
    AND PID NOT IN (SELECT PID FROM shahrukh_pid)
),
movies_with_actors_with_shahrukh AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT MID FROM M_Cast 
    WHERE PID IN (SELECT PID FROM actors_with_shahrukh)
    AND MID NOT IN (SELECT MID FROM movies_with_shahrukh)
),
actors_2_deg AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT PID FROM M_Cast 
    WHERE MID IN (SELECT MID FROM movies_with_actors_with_shahrukh)
    AND PID NOT IN (SELECT PID FROM shahrukh_pid)
    AND PID NOT IN (SELECT PID FROM actors_with_shahrukh)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM actors_2_deg
